hidden.why: Each buyer's chosen number stays secret until (and, for losers, after) the draw, so the organizer cannot pick an unsold number or a friend's number and buyers cannot copy each other.
Commitment randomness; also the nullifier secret.
Leaf position identifies which purchase is claiming.
Holed only: identifies the purchase slot.
Draw-commitment randomness until reveal (revealed by design in draw).

mayReveal.why: Public commitment to the winning number.
A claim proves a winning ticket; the winning number is public anyway.
Payout address must be public to pay out.
Only the Merkle root, already public.
Only the nullifier hash(domain, salt); unlinkable to the leaf.
Only inside a commitment with a 256-bit salt.

acceptedLeakage: Number of tickets sold and number of winning claims.
Who bought a ticket (the wallet paying fees) is visible outside the contract.
The payout address of each winner.

unlinkable.why: A winner's claim must not reveal which purchase (and thus which buyer wallet) it came from.
